en.forex_infoBox: Leveraged trading on gold and major currency pairs, executed directly against gTrade's smart contract on Arbitrum — not through their website. Stop loss and take profit are fully automatic, enforced by the contract itself, not by us or by gTrade manually. Leverage amplifies both gains and losses — start small.

en.heat_infoBox: A coin needs a score above 70 AND at least 2 independent signals active (of: volume acceleration, open-interest growth, funding-rate jump, 24h-high breakout) to show up here at all — so this list is meant to be short and selective, not exhaustive. "Building Up" means the signals are active but price hasn't moved much yet (earlier, higher risk). "Already Hot" means price already moved noticeably — confirmed momentum, lower (but still real) risk.

en.swap_title: Buy crypto, gold or tokenized stocks
en.swap_infoBox: Swap between cryptocurrencies, tokenized gold and tokenized stocks. Everything is non-custodial: swaps on one network go straight to on-chain pools, and moves between networks use bridges (deBridge, Relay, Symbiosis) signed by your own wallet. No funds are ever held by us or by a middleman.
en.swap_enterAmount: Enter an amount to see the estimate.
en.stocks_desc: Live prices from public market data. Buy and sell tokenized exposure (xStock) directly below — settles on Solana.
en.stocks_infoBox: These are tokens whose price tracks a real stock's price (like Apple or Tesla), but they are not the stock itself — no shareholder rights, no voting, no dividends unless stated. It's a Solana-based token (xStock) that mirrors the price. Trades 24/7, unlike the real stock market which has open/close hours.

en.pump_trendDesc: Tokens under an hour old, ranked by organic reply activity — not speed, momentum.

en.pump_infoBox: Pump.fun is a platform on Solana where anyone can create a new token in seconds, no coding needed. Price is set by a math formula (a "bonding curve"), not real buyers/sellers like a normal exchange. Most of these tokens have no real value behind them and can lose most of their value within hours. This is extreme-risk territory — only for money you're fully OK losing, not regular investing.

en.pump_volatilityWarning: New, low-liquidity tokens are extremely volatile and can lose most of their value quickly. Not financial advice.
en.pump_automationDesc: DCA runs fully on-chain via Jupiter, signed by your own wallet — nothing is ever held by our server. Price alerts just notify you on Telegram when your target hits; you review and sign the trade yourself at that moment.
en.pump_trackDesc: Get a notification whenever a specific Solana wallet makes a Pump.fun transaction. Up to 13 wallets.

en.wallet_infoBox: This wallet is fully non-custodial — MarketRadar never sees or stores your private key or 12-word recovery phrase. That means: no one (not even us) can freeze or take your funds. But it also means if you lose your recovery phrase or PIN, there is no way to recover it — not us, not support, no one. Write your recovery phrase on paper and keep it somewhere safe, never as a screenshot.
en.wallet_usdtRiskBox: Non-custodial means we can't freeze your funds, but Tether (the company behind USDT) technically can, on any address — this isn't about MarketRadar or this wallet specifically. In practice this is rare and almost always tied to an address flagged as connected to a sanctioned entity (e.g. a sanctioned exchange), not applied broadly by country. To keep this risk low: avoid depositing directly from an exchange under sanctions, and consider keeping part of your balance in BTC or SOL instead of only USDT — those have no central issuer that can freeze an address at all.
